packages.name: Goa Beach Paradise
packages.description: Experience the magic of Goa with this all-inclusive package. Explore beautiful beaches, historic churches, and immerse yourself in the vibrant culture. This package includes luxury accommodation, daily breakfast, guided tours, and airport transfers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa
itinerary.description: Arrive at Goa International Airport. Transfer to your beachfront resort in North Goa. Welcome dinner and briefing about your upcoming adventure.

itinerary.title: North Goa Exploration
itinerary.description: Explore the popular beaches of North Goa including Baga, Calangute, and Anjuna. Evening visit to the famous Saturday Night Market.

itinerary.title: Old Goa Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Full-day tour of Old Goa's UNESCO World Heritage sites including Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral. Evening cruise on the Mandovi River with cultural performances.

itinerary.title: South Goa Beaches
itinerary.description: Visit the serene beaches of South Goa including Palolem and Agonda. Enjoy a beachside seafood lunch and relaxation time.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Free time for last-minute shopping. Transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: Manali Adventure
packages.description: Discover the beauty of Manali in this exciting adventure package. Enjoy snow-capped mountains, adventure activities, and charming mountain villages. This package includes accommodation in a mountain resort, equipment rental, and guided excursions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bhuntar Airport or by road. Transfer to your hotel in Manali. Evening orientation walk and welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs, and the Tibetan Monastery. Evening free to explore Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Excursion
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to Solang Valley. Enjoy adventure activities like paragliding, zorbing, and skiing (seasonal).

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass Visit
itinerary.description: Day trip to the famous Rohtang Pass (subject to weather conditions and permits). Enjoy snow activities and breathtaking views.

itinerary.title: River Rafting & Kullu
itinerary.description: Morning river rafting on Beas River. Afternoon visit to Kullu for local handicraft shopping.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Check out from hotel. Transfer to Bhuntar Airport or bus station for your onward journey.

packages.name: Cool Daman Getaway
packages.description: Escape to the tranquil shores of Daman on this 2-day coastal getaway. Explore historical forts, peaceful beaches, and Portuguese-era churches. Perfect for a quick break from the city, this tour includes guided visits, local sightseeing, and plenty of time to unwind by the sea.

itinerary.title: Historic Forts and Beaches
itinerary.description: Start the day with a visit to the grand Moti Daman Fort followed by relaxation at Jampore Beach. Enjoy birdwatching at Daman Aviary and end the day with a scenic view from the Daman Lighthouse.

itinerary.title: Colonial Charm and Culture
itinerary.description: Explore the architectural beauty of the Cathedral of Bom Jesus. Visit the historic Nani Daman Fort, St Jerome Fort, and the peaceful Dominican Monastery.

packages.name: Rajasthan Heritage Tour
packages.description: Explore the royal heritage of Rajasthan with this comprehensive tour. Visit magnificent forts and palaces, experience desert safari, and enjoy traditional Rajasthani hospitality. This package includes heritage hotel stays, guided tours, and cultural experiences.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur
itinerary.description: Arrive at Jaipur International Airport. Transfer to your heritage hotel. Evening orientation walk.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Amber Fort, City Palace, Hawa Mahal, and Jantar Mantar. Evening cultural show with dinner.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur
itinerary.description: Drive to Jodhpur. En route visit Pushkar. Check into your hotel in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, and Umaid Bhawan Palace. Evening walk through the blue city.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Jaisalmer
itinerary.description: Drive to Jaisalmer. Check into your desert resort. Evening visit to Gadisar Lake.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Fort & Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Jaisalmer Fort and Patwon Ki Haveli. Afternoon desert safari with camel ride and cultural performances.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer to Udaipur
itinerary.description: Drive to Udaipur. En route visit Ranakpur Jain Temple. Evening boat ride on Lake Pichola.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Visit City Palace and Saheliyon Ki Bari. Transfer to Udaipur Airport for departure.

packages.name: Ladakh Adventure
packages.description: Embark on an adventure to the roof of the world with this Ladakh tour. Experience breathtaking landscapes, ancient monasteries, and unique culture. This package includes accommodation, oxygen support, and experienced guides for high-altitude travel.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
itinerary.description: Arrive at Leh Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Rest day for acclimatization.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, and local market. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Monastery Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Thiksey, Hemis, and Shey Monasteries. Experience Buddhist culture and traditions.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
itinerary.description: Drive to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass (one of the highest motorable roads). Visit Diskit Monastery and Hunder sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Panamik hot springs and Sumur village. Evening stargazing session.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
itinerary.description: Drive to Pangong Lake via Shyok River route. Evening by the lake enjoying the changing colors.

itinerary.title: Pangong Lake to Leh
itinerary.description: Morning at Pangong Lake. Return to Leh via Chang La Pass. Evening at leisure in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Tsomoriri Lake
itinerary.description: Day trip to Tsomoriri Lake. Visit Chumathang hot springs en route. Return to Leh by evening.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Leh Airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: Andaman Island Escape
packages.description: Escape to the pristine Andaman Islands with this tropical package. Enjoy crystal clear waters, white sand beaches, and rich marine life. This package includes island transfers, water activities, and comfortable beachside accommodation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair
itinerary.description: Arrive at Veer Savarkar International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Visit Cellular Jail and attend the Light and Sound show.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock Island. Check into your beach resort. Visit Radhanagar Beach for sunset.

itinerary.title: Havelock Island Activities
itinerary.description: Scuba diving or snorkeling at Elephant Beach. Afternoon at leisure to enjoy the beach.

itinerary.title: Havelock to Neil Island
itinerary.description: Ferry to Neil Island. Visit Bharatpur Beach, Natural Bridge, and Laxmanpur Beach.

itinerary.title: Neil Island to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure in Neil Island. Afternoon ferry to Port Blair. Evening shopping at Aberdeen Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Visit Ross Island and North Bay Island (Coral Island). Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Bali Paradise Getaway
packages.description: Experience the magic of Bali with this comprehensive package. Explore lush rice terraces, ancient temples, and pristine beaches. Enjoy traditional Balinese culture, cuisine, and relaxation in this tropical paradise.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Kuta. Welcome dinner with traditional Balinese dance performance.

itinerary.title: Kuta Beach & Tanah Lot
itinerary.description: Morning at Kuta Beach with optional surfing lessons. Afternoon visit to Tanah Lot Temple for sunset views.

itinerary.title: Ubud Cultural Day
itinerary.description: Full day tour of Ubud including Monkey Forest, Ubud Palace, and local art markets. Visit a traditional Balinese home.

itinerary.title: Tegalalang & Kintamani
itinerary.description: Visit the famous Tegalalang Rice Terraces. Continue to Kintamani for views of Mount Batur and Lake Batur. Coffee plantation tour.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu & Jimbaran
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon visit to Uluwatu Temple with Kecak Fire Dance. Seafood dinner at Jimbaran Bay.

itinerary.title: Nusa Dua Water Activities
itinerary.description: Full day of water activities at Nusa Dua Beach including parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat. Afternoon spa treatment.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Free time for last-minute shopping. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Vietnam Heritage Tour
packages.description: Discover the rich heritage and natural beauty of Vietnam. From bustling cities to serene landscapes, experience the diverse culture, history, and cuisine of this fascinating country.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Hanoi. Evening water puppet show followed by welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Hanoi City Tour
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Hanoi including Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature, and Hoan Kiem Lake. Evening street food tour.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay
itinerary.description: Drive to Halong Bay. Board your overnight cruise. Explore caves, go kayaking, and enjoy seafood dinner on board.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay to Hoi An
itinerary.description: Morning Tai Chi on deck. Disembark and transfer to airport for flight to Da Nang. Drive to Hoi An. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Hoi An Ancient Town
itinerary.description: Walking tour of UNESCO-listed Hoi An Ancient Town. Afternoon cooking class to learn Vietnamese cuisine.

itinerary.title: Hoi An to Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City. Afternoon city tour including Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, and Ben Thanh Market.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels & Mekong Delta
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Cu Chi Tunnels. Afternoon boat trip in Mekong Delta with visits to local villages and fruit orchards.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Free time until transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for departure.

packages.name: Maldives Luxury Retreat
packages.description: Indulge in luxury at this exclusive Maldives retreat. Stay in an overwater villa, explore vibrant coral reefs, and enjoy personalized services in one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Male
itinerary.description: Arrive at Velana International Airport. Speedboat or seaplane transfer to your resort. Welcome drink and resort orientation.

itinerary.title: Snorkeling Adventure
itinerary.description: Morning guided snorkeling tour of the house reef. Afternoon at leisure to enjoy your villa and resort facilities.

itinerary.title: Island Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit a local island to experience Maldivian culture. Afternoon spa treatment with ocean views.

itinerary.title: Water Activities
itinerary.description: Morning water sports including jet skiing, parasailing, and paddleboarding. Evening sunset cruise with dolphins spotting and champagne.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Free morning to enjoy last moments in paradise. Transfer to Male International Airport for departure.

packages.name: Dubai City Explorer
packages.description: Experience the glamour and excitement of Dubai with this comprehensive city package. Visit iconic landmarks, enjoy thrilling desert adventures, and indulge in world-class shopping and dining.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening Dhow cruise dinner along Dubai Creek.

itinerary.title: Modern Dubai Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Burj Khalifa (124th floor), Dubai Mall, Dubai Fountain show, and Dubai Marina. Photo stop at Burj Al Arab.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon desert safari with dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding, and BBQ dinner with entertainment.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Day Trip
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Abu Dhabi visiting Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Ferrari World (outside view), and Corniche.

itinerary.title: Old Dubai & Shopping
itinerary.description: Visit Al Fahidi Historical District, Dubai Museum, and Gold & Spice Souks. Cross Dubai Creek by abra. Afternoon shopping at Mall of Emirates.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Free time until transfer to Dubai International Airport for departure.

packages.name: Singapore Family Fun
packages.description: Perfect for families, this Singapore package offers a blend of entertainment, education, and excitement. Enjoy world-class attractions, delicious cuisine, and the perfect mix of nature and urban experiences.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore
itinerary.description: Arrive at Changi International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to Gardens by the Bay with Garden Rhapsody light show.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Full day at Universal Studios Singapore on Sentosa Island. Enjoy rides, shows, and attractions based on popular movies.

itinerary.title: Singapore Zoo & Night Safari
itinerary.description: Morning at award-winning Singapore Zoo. Afternoon at River Wonders. Evening at Night Safari to see nocturnal animals.

itinerary.title: City Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Merlion Park, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, Chinatown, and Little India. Evening shopping on Orchard Road.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Last-minute shopping at Jewel Changi Airport before your departure flight.

packages.name: Thailand Beach & Culture
packages.description: Experience the perfect blend of culture and relaxation in Thailand. Explore bustling Bangkok, visit ancient temples, and unwind on pristine beaches in Phuket and Phi Phi Islands.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok
itinerary.description: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening Chao Phraya dinner cruise.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Grand Palace, Wat Phra Kaew (Emerald Buddha), Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha), and Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn).

itinerary.title: Bangkok to Phuket
itinerary.description: Morning at Damnoen Saduak Floating Market. Afternoon flight to Phuket. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands Tour
itinerary.description: Full day speedboat tour to Phi Phi Islands including Maya Bay, Monkey Beach, and snorkeling at coral reefs.

itinerary.title: Phuket Free Day
itinerary.description: Day at leisure to enjoy your resort or explore nearby beaches. Optional Thai massage.

itinerary.title: Elephant Sanctuary & Cooking Class
itinerary.description: Morning visit to ethical elephant sanctuary. Afternoon Thai cooking class to learn authentic recipes.

itinerary.title: Phang Nga Bay Tour
itinerary.description: Full day tour of Phang Nga Bay including James Bond Island, sea cave canoeing, and Muslim fishing village on stilts.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Free time until transfer to Phuket International Airport for departure flight.

packages.name: Nepal Himalayan Trek
packages.description: Embark on an unforgettable Himalayan adventure in Nepal. Trek through stunning mountain landscapes, experience rich cultural heritage, and enjoy the natural beauty of this mountainous country.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Kathmandu. Evening briefing about your trek.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Tour
itinerary.description: Visit UNESCO World Heritage Sites including Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, and Kathmandu Durbar Square.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Lukla to Phakding
itinerary.description: Early morning flight to Lukla. Begin trek to Phakding (2,652m) through Sherpa villages and pine forests.

itinerary.title: Phakding to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Trek to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the gateway to Everest. Cross suspension bridges over Dudh Koshi River.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day
itinerary.description: Rest day in Namche Bazaar for acclimatization. Optional hike to Everest View Hotel for panoramic mountain views.

itinerary.title: Namche to Tengboche
itinerary.description: Trek to Tengboche (3,870m), home to the famous Tengboche Monastery with views of Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam.

itinerary.title: Tengboche to Dingboche
itinerary.description: Trek to Dingboche (4,360m) through rhododendron forests and summer yak pastures.

itinerary.title: Dingboche to Lobuche
itinerary.description: Trek to Lobuche (4,940m) past the Khumbu Glacier and memorial stupas for climbers who perished on Everest.

itinerary.title: Lobuche to Gorak Shep to EBC
itinerary.description: Trek to Gorak Shep (5,170m), then to Everest Base Camp (5,364m). Return to Gorak Shep for overnight.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Early morning hike to Kala Patthar for sunrise views of Everest. Return to Gorak Shep and begin descent.

packages.name: Bhutan Cultural Tour
packages.description: Discover the Land of the Thunder Dragon with this immersive cultural tour. Experience Bhutan's unique Buddhist culture, visit ancient monasteries, and enjoy breathtaking Himalayan landscapes in this mystical kingdom.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paro
itinerary.description: Arrive at Paro International Airport. Transfer to Thimphu, the capital city. Visit Memorial Chorten and Buddha Point.

itinerary.title: Thimphu Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Tashichho Dzong, Folk Heritage Museum, Traditional Paper Factory, and Textile Museum. Evening at Thimphu Craft Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha
itinerary.description: Drive to Punakha via Dochula Pass (3,100m) with views of Himalayan peaks. Visit Chimi Lhakhang, the Temple of Fertility.

itinerary.title: Punakha Valley
itinerary.description: Visit Punakha Dzong, the Palace of Great Happiness, situated at the confluence of Mo Chhu and Pho Chhu rivers. Hike to Khamsum Yulley Namgyal Chorten.

itinerary.title: Punakha to Paro
itinerary.description: Drive back to Paro. Visit Ta Dzong (National Museum) and Rinpung Dzong. Evening stroll through Paro town.

itinerary.title: Tiger's Nest Monastery
itinerary.description: Hike to the iconic Taktsang Monastery (Tiger's Nest) perched on a cliff 900m above the valley floor. Afternoon visit to Kyichu Lhakhang, one of the oldest temples in Bhutan.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Paro International Airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: Sri Lanka Heritage Circuit
packages.description: Experience the rich cultural heritage and natural beauty of Sri Lanka. Visit ancient cities, lush tea plantations, wildlife reserves, and beautiful beaches in this tropical island paradise.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Colombo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Colombo. Evening city tour including Gangaramaya Temple and Independence Square.

itinerary.title: Colombo to Anuradhapura
itinerary.description: Drive to the ancient city of Anuradhapura. Visit the Sacred Bo Tree, Ruwanwelisaya Stupa, and other archaeological sites.

itinerary.title: Anuradhapura to Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Mihintale, the cradle of Buddhism in Sri Lanka. Continue to Sigiriya. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya & Polonnaruwa
itinerary.description: Morning climb to Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Afternoon visit to the ancient city of Polonnaruwa.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya to Kandy
itinerary.description: Drive to Kandy, visiting Dambulla Cave Temple and a spice garden en route. Evening cultural show in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic. Drive to Nuwara Eliya through tea plantations. Visit a tea factory.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya to Yala
itinerary.description: Drive to Yala National Park. Afternoon safari to spot elephants, leopards, and other wildlife.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Drive to Colombo via the southern coast. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Japan Cherry Blossom Tour
packages.description: Experience the magical cherry blossom season in Japan with this comprehensive tour. Visit Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and more while enjoying the beautiful sakura blooms. This package includes luxury accommodations, bullet train tickets, and guided tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Narita International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Tokyo. Evening orientation walk in Shinjuku.

itinerary.title: Tokyo Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Meiji Shrine, Harajuku, Shibuya Crossing, and Tokyo Skytree. Evening cherry blossom viewing at Ueno Park.

itinerary.title: Tokyo to Mt. Fuji
itinerary.description: Day trip to Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Cruise on Lake Ashi and ride the Hakone Ropeway for views of Mt. Fuji.

itinerary.title: Tokyo to Kyoto
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Tsukiji Outer Market. Afternoon bullet train to Kyoto. Evening walk in Gion district.

itinerary.title: Kyoto Temples
itinerary.description: Visit Kinkakuji (Golden Pavilion), Ryoanji Temple, and Arashiyama Bamboo Grove. Cherry blossom viewing at Maruyama Park.

itinerary.title: Kyoto to Nara
itinerary.description: Day trip to Nara. Visit Todaiji Temple, Nara Park with its friendly deer, and Kasuga Taisha Shrine.

itinerary.title: Kyoto to Osaka
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Fushimi Inari Shrine. Afternoon transfer to Osaka. Evening in Dotonbori district.

itinerary.title: Osaka Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Osaka Castle, Umeda Sky Building, and Kuromon Market. Evening cherry blossom viewing at Osaka Castle Park.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Kansai International Airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: Egypt Pyramids & Nile Cruise
packages.description: Discover the ancient wonders of Egypt with this comprehensive tour. Visit the Great Pyramids, cruise along the Nile River, and explore ancient temples and tombs. This package includes luxury accommodations, Nile cruise, and expert Egyptologist guides.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cairo International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening welcome dinner with orientation.

itinerary.title: Pyramids & Sphinx
itinerary.description: Visit the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Valley Temple. Afternoon visit to the Egyptian Museum.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Luxor
itinerary.description: Fly to Luxor. Visit Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple. Check in to your Nile cruise ship.

itinerary.title: Luxor West Bank
itinerary.description: Visit the Valley of the Kings, Temple of Hatshepsut, and Colossi of Memnon. Afternoon sailing to Edfu.

itinerary.title: Edfu to Kom Ombo
itinerary.description: Visit Edfu Temple, dedicated to the falcon god Horus. Sail to Kom Ombo and visit the unique double temple.

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo to Aswan
itinerary.description: Sail to Aswan. Visit the High Dam, the Unfinished Obelisk, and Philae Temple. Evening Nubian village visit.

itinerary.title: Aswan to Cairo
itinerary.description: Optional early morning excursion to Abu Simbel temples. Fly back to Cairo. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: New Zealand Adventure
packages.description: Experience the stunning landscapes and adventure activities of New Zealand. From the geothermal wonders of the North Island to the breathtaking fjords of the South Island, this tour offers the best of New Zealand's natural beauty and adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Arrive at Auckland International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening harbor dinner cruise.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua
itinerary.description: Drive to Rotorua via Hobbiton Movie Set. Evening Maori cultural performance and traditional hangi dinner.

itinerary.title: Rotorua Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Te Puia Geothermal Park, Wai-O-Tapu, and Polynesian Spa. Afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Fly to Queenstown. Afternoon orientation tour including Skyline Gondola with panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Milford Sound including a scenic cruise through the fjord.

itinerary.title: Queenstown Adventure
itinerary.description: Choose from various adventure activities: bungy jumping, jet boating, skydiving, or hiking.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to Wanaka
itinerary.description: Drive to Wanaka via Arrowtown. Visit Cardrona Distillery and enjoy the lakeside town of Wanaka.

itinerary.title: Wanaka to Franz Josef
itinerary.description: Drive to Franz Josef Glacier via Haast Pass. Short walk to view the glacier.

itinerary.title: Franz Josef to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Drive to Christchurch via Hokitika and Arthur's Pass. Evening at leisure in Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Christchurch International Airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: South Africa Safari
packages.description: Experience the wildlife and natural beauty of South Africa. Go on safari in Kruger National Park, explore vibrant Cape Town, and enjoy the scenic Garden Route. This package includes luxury lodges, game drives, and guided tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Arrive at O.R. Tambo International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Johannesburg to Kruger
itinerary.description: Fly to Kruger National Park. Transfer to your safari lodge. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Kruger Safari
itinerary.description: Full day of game drives in Kruger National Park searching for the Big Five (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo).

itinerary.title: Kruger to Cape Town
itinerary.description: Morning game drive. Fly to Cape Town. Transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure at the V&A Waterfront.

itinerary.title: Cape Town City Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Table Mountain (weather permitting), Company Gardens, Castle of Good Hope, and Bo-Kaap neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Cape Peninsula
itinerary.description: Full day tour of Cape Peninsula including Cape Point, Cape of Good Hope, and Boulders Beach penguin colony.

itinerary.title: Cape Winelands
itinerary.description: Day trip to Stellenbosch and Franschhoek for wine tasting and gourmet lunch.

itinerary.title: Garden Route
itinerary.description: Fly to Port Elizabeth. Drive along part of the Garden Route to Knysna. Evening sunset cruise on Knysna Lagoon.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to George Airport for flight to Johannesburg and international connection.

packages.name: Greek Islands Hopping
packages.description: Experience the beauty of the Greek Islands with this island-hopping package. Visit Athens, Santorini, Mykonos, and Crete, enjoying beautiful beaches, ancient ruins, and delicious Greek cuisine. This package includes ferry tickets, accommodations, and guided tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening walking tour of Plaka neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Athens Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit the Acropolis, Parthenon, Acropolis Museum, and Ancient Agora. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Athens to Mykonos
itinerary.description: Morning ferry to Mykonos. Transfer to your hotel. Afternoon at leisure to explore Mykonos Town.

itinerary.title: Mykonos Beaches
itinerary.description: Day at leisure to enjoy the famous beaches of Mykonos such as Paradise, Super Paradise, or Elia.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Santorini
itinerary.description: Morning ferry to Santorini. Transfer to your hotel in Oia or Fira. Evening sunset viewing in Oia.

itinerary.title: Santorini Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Akrotiri archaeological site, Red Beach, and black sand beaches. Afternoon wine tasting at a local vineyard.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Crete
itinerary.description: Morning ferry to Heraklion, Crete. Visit the Palace of Knossos. Transfer to your hotel in Chania.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Heraklion Airport for flight to Athens and international connection.

packages.name: Statue of Unity Day Trip
packages.description: Experience the magnificent Statue of Unity, the world's tallest statue at 182 meters, in this affordable one-day package. Visit the viewing gallery for panoramic views, explore the Valley of Flowers, and witness the spectacular laser show. Package includes transportation, entry tickets, and guided tour.

itinerary.title: Statue of Unity Day Trip
itinerary.description: Early morning departure from Vadodara. Visit the colossal Statue of Unity dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Explore the museum, Valley of Flowers, and enjoy the spectacular view from the viewing gallery. Witness the laser show in the evening before returning.

packages.name: Kashi Darshan Pilgrimage
packages.description: Embark on a spiritual journey to one of India's holiest cities. Experience the divine Ganga Aarti, visit the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Temple, explore Buddhist site Sarnath, and take a serene boat ride along the ghats of Varanasi. This package includes accommodation, temple visits, and guided spiritual tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Varanasi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Varanasi Airport/Railway Station. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to Dashashwamedh Ghat to witness the spectacular Ganga Aarti ceremony.

itinerary.title: Kashi Vishwanath & Ghats
itinerary.description: Early morning boat ride on the River Ganges. Visit the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Temple and other important temples. Explore the ancient ghats and narrow lanes of Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Sarnath Excursion
itinerary.description: Day trip to Sarnath, where Buddha gave his first sermon. Visit the Dhamek Stupa, Archaeological Museum, and Ashoka Pillar. Evening free for shopping or relaxation.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Early morning yoga session by the Ganges (optional). Time for last darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple. Transfer to airport/railway station for departure.

packages.name: Char Dham Yatra
packages.description: Undertake the sacred Char Dham Yatra, visiting the four holy shrines of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath in the Garhwal Himalayas. This comprehensive package includes accommodation, transportation, meals, and experienced guides to make your spiritual journey comfortable and meaningful.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Haridwar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Haridwar. Transfer to hotel. Evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Barkot
itinerary.description: Drive from Haridwar to Barkot. En route visit Kempty Falls in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Yamunotri Darshan
itinerary.description: Drive to Janki Chatti and trek to Yamunotri Temple. Return to Barkot for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Barkot to Uttarkashi
itinerary.description: Drive from Barkot to Uttarkashi. Visit Vishwanath Temple in the evening.

itinerary.title: Gangotri Darshan
itinerary.description: Day trip to Gangotri Temple. Return to Uttarkashi for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Drive from Uttarkashi to Guptkashi via Tehri Dam.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath Darshan
itinerary.description: Drive to Sonprayag, trek or take helicopter to Kedarnath Temple. Overnight stay in Kedarnath.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Morning prayers at Kedarnath Temple. Return to Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Badrinath
itinerary.description: Drive from Guptkashi to Badrinath via Joshimath.

itinerary.title: Badrinath Darshan
itinerary.description: Visit Badrinath Temple and nearby attractions including Mana Village, the last Indian village before Tibet.

itinerary.title: Badrinath to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Drive from Badrinath to Rishikesh. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure from Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Morning yoga session (optional). Visit famous ashrams and temples in Rishikesh. Transfer to Haridwar for departure.

packages.name: Rann of Kutch Festival
packages.description: Experience the magical Rann Utsav at the White Desert of Kutch. Stay in traditional tents, enjoy cultural performances, taste authentic Kutchi cuisine, and shop for colorful handicrafts. This package includes luxury tent accommodation, meals, cultural programs, and desert safari.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhuj
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bhuj Airport/Railway Station. Transfer to the Rann Utsav tent city in Dhordo. Evening visit to White Rann to witness the sunset.

itinerary.title: White Rann & Cultural Day
itinerary.description: Morning visit to White Rann. Afternoon explore local villages and handicraft centers. Evening cultural performances and dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Morning camel cart ride. Visit to Kala Dungar (Black Hill) for panoramic views. Transfer to Bhuj for departure.

packages.name: Amritsar Golden Temple
packages.description: Visit the spiritual and historical city of Amritsar. Experience the divine atmosphere of the Golden Temple, witness the patriotic Wagah Border ceremony, and explore the historical Jallianwala Bagh. This package includes accommodation, guided tours, and authentic Punjabi meals.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amritsar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Amritsar Airport/Railway Station. Transfer to hotel. Visit the Golden Temple and participate in the evening Palki Sahib ceremony. Dinner at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Amritsar Exploration & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Jallianwala Bagh and heritage walk through old Amritsar. Afternoon visit to Wagah Border to witness the retreat ceremony. Transfer to airport/railway station for departure.

packages.name: Ajanta & Ellora Caves
packages.description: Explore the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Ajanta and Ellora Caves near Aurangabad. Marvel at the ancient rock-cut caves with stunning sculptures and paintings. This package includes accommodation, guided tours, and entrance fees to all monuments.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Ellora Caves
itinerary.description: Arrive at Aurangabad Airport/Railway Station. Transfer to hotel. Visit Ellora Caves featuring Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain monuments. Evening visit to Bibi Ka Maqbara (Mini Taj Mahal).

itinerary.title: Ajanta Caves & Departure
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Ajanta Caves with their magnificent Buddhist paintings and sculptures. Transfer to airport/railway station for departure.

packages.name: Hampi Heritage Tour
packages.description: Step back in time at the ancient city of Hampi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the magnificent ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire with its temples, palaces, and monuments. This package includes accommodation, guided tours, and transportation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hampi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Hospet Railway Station. Transfer to hotel in Hampi. Visit Virupaksha Temple and Hemakuta Hill for sunset.

itinerary.title: Hampi Monuments
itinerary.description: Full day exploration of Hampi's main attractions including Vittala Temple, Stone Chariot, Queen's Bath, and Hazara Rama Temple.

itinerary.title: Hampi & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Lotus Mahal, Elephant Stables, and Underground Shiva Temple. Transfer to Hospet for departure.

packages.name: Somnath & Dwarka Darshan
packages.description: Embark on a spiritual journey to the sacred temples of Somnath and Dwarka in Gujarat. Visit the revered Jyotirlinga at Somnath and the ancient kingdom of Lord Krishna at Dwarka. This package includes accommodation, temple visits, and transportation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Somnath
itinerary.description: Arrive at Veraval/Somnath. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to Somnath Temple for darshan and light & sound show.

itinerary.title: Somnath to Dwarka
itinerary.description: Morning aarti at Somnath Temple. Drive to Dwarka. En route visit Porbandar (birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi).

itinerary.title: Dwarka Exploration
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Dwarkadheesh Temple. Boat ride to Bet Dwarka. Visit Nageshwar Jyotirlinga and Rukmini Temple.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Morning darshan at Dwarkadheesh Temple. Transfer to Jamnagar Airport/Railway Station for departure.

packages.name: Shirdi Sai Darshan
packages.description: Experience the divine blessings of Sai Baba in Shirdi. Visit the sacred Samadhi Mandir, Dwarkamai, and other places associated with Sai Baba's life. This package includes accommodation, VIP darshan, and guided tour of all important sites.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Shirdi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Shirdi. Transfer to hotel. Visit Sai Baba Temple for darshan. Evening aarti participation.

itinerary.title: Shirdi Exploration & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning darshan at Sai Baba Temple. Visit Dwarkamai, Chavadi, Gurusthan, and Lendi Garden. Departure from Shirdi.

packages.name: Udaipur Day Tour
packages.description: Explore the romantic city of Udaipur in this comprehensive day tour. Visit the magnificent City Palace, take a boat ride on Lake Pichola, and explore beautiful gardens and temples. This package includes transportation, guide, entrance fees, and boat ride.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Tour
itinerary.description: Morning pickup from your hotel. Visit City Palace, Jagdish Temple, and Saheliyon Ki Bari (Garden of Maidens). Enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola with views of Lake Palace. Evening drop-off at your hotel.

packages.name: Agra Taj Mahal Day Trip
packages.description: Experience the wonder of the Taj Mahal in this comprehensive day trip to Agra. Visit the iconic Taj Mahal, explore the magnificent Agra Fort, and enjoy the sunset view from Mehtab Bagh. This package includes transportation, guide, and entrance fees.

itinerary.title: Agra Day Trip
itinerary.description: Early morning pickup from Delhi. Drive to Agra. Visit the magnificent Taj Mahal and learn about its history and architecture. Explore Agra Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Sunset view of Taj Mahal from Mehtab Bagh. Return to Delhi by evening.

packages.name: Tirupati Balaji Darshan
packages.description: Seek the blessings of Lord Venkateshwara at the sacred Tirumala Temple in Tirupati. This package includes special darshan arrangements, accommodation, transportation, and visits to nearby temples.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tirupati
itinerary.description: Arrive at Tirupati Airport/Railway Station. Transfer to hotel. Visit Padmavati Temple and ISKCON Temple in Tirupati.

itinerary.title: Tirumala Darshan & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning transfer to Tirumala. Special darshan at Tirumala Temple. Visit Akasa Ganga and other sacred spots. Return to Tirupati for departure.

packages.name: Rishikesh & Haridwar Spiritual Tour
packages.description: Experience spiritual awakening in the yoga capital of the world, Rishikesh, and the holy city of Haridwar. Participate in the divine Ganga Aarti, visit ancient temples and ashrams, and enjoy adventure activities like river rafting. This package includes accommodation, spiritual activities, and adventure sports.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Haridwar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Haridwar. Transfer to hotel. Evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Morning temple visits in Haridwar. Transfer to Rishikesh. Visit Laxman Jhula, Ram Jhula, and famous ashrams.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning yoga session. River rafting experience on the Ganges. Evening Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan. Departure from Rishikesh.

packages.name: Jaipur Pink City Day Tour
packages.description: Explore the magnificent Pink City of Jaipur in this comprehensive day tour. Visit the majestic Amber Fort, City Palace, iconic Hawa Mahal, and the astronomical wonder Jantar Mantar. This package includes transportation, guide, and entrance fees.

itinerary.title: Jaipur City Tour
itinerary.description: Morning pickup from your hotel. Visit Amber Fort with elephant ride (subject to availability). Explore City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and Hawa Mahal. Shopping time at local bazaars. Evening drop-off at your hotel.

packages.name: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan
packages.description: Experience the divine blessings of Lord Shiva at the revered Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga in Ujjain. Participate in the sacred Bhasma Aarti and visit other important temples in this ancient city. This package includes accommodation, special darshan, and guided temple tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ujjain
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ujjain. Transfer to hotel. Visit Mahakaleshwar Temple for evening darshan. Visit Kal Bhairav Temple and Ram Ghat.

itinerary.title: Bhasma Aarti & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning Bhasma Aarti at Mahakaleshwar Temple. Visit Harsiddhi Temple and other sacred sites. Departure from Ujjain.

packages.name: Kerala Backwaters
packages.description: Experience the tranquility of Kerala's backwaters in this relaxing package. Cruise on traditional houseboats, enjoy Ayurvedic treatments, and explore lush tea plantations. This package includes luxury accommodation, daily meals, and cultural experiences.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kochi International Airport. Transfer to your hotel. Evening Kathakali dance performance.

itinerary.title: Kochi City Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Fort Kochi including the Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, and Mattancherry Palace. Evening harbor cruise.

itinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.description: Drive to Munnar through scenic routes with spice plantation visits. Check into your resort in the tea plantations.

itinerary.title: Munnar Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park, Tea Museum, and Mattupetty Dam. Evening leisure time to enjoy the cool climate.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey. Board your private houseboat for an overnight cruise through the backwaters.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam
itinerary.description: Disembark from houseboat. Drive to Kovalam beach. Evening free to relax on the beach.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.description: Transfer to Trivandrum International Airport for your departure flight.

packages.name: Khajuraho Temples Tour
packages.description: Explore the magnificent UNESCO World Heritage temples of Khajuraho, famous for their exquisite sculptures and Nagara-style architecture. This package includes accommodation, guided temple tours, and a visit to the scenic Raneh Falls.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Khajuraho
itinerary.description: Arrive at Khajuraho Airport. Transfer to hotel. Visit Western Group of Temples. Evening Light & Sound Show.

itinerary.title: Khajuraho Exploration & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Eastern Group of Temples. Excursion to Raneh Falls. Departure from Khajuraho.

packages.name: Konark & Puri Temple Tour
packages.description: Visit the architectural marvel of Konark Sun Temple and seek blessings at the sacred Jagannath Temple in Puri. This package includes accommodation, temple visits, and excursions to nearby attractions like Chilika Lake and Raghurajpur Artist Village.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhubaneswar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bhubaneswar Airport. Transfer to Puri. Evening visit to Puri Beach.

itinerary.title: Konark & Puri Temples
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Konark Sun Temple. Afternoon darshan at Jagannath Temple in Puri. Evening free for shopping.

itinerary.title: Excursion & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning excursion to Chilika Lake and Raghurajpur Artist Village. Transfer to Bhubaneswar for departure.

packages.name: Gir National Park Safari
packages.description: Experience the thrill of spotting the majestic Asiatic Lion in its only natural habitat in the world. Enjoy jeep safaris in Gir National Park and explore the rich biodiversity of this unique ecosystem. This package includes accommodation, safari permits, and guided tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gir
itinerary.description: Arrive at Gir. Transfer to resort. Evening safari in Gir National Park.

itinerary.title: Morning Safari & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning safari in Gir National Park. Visit to Kamleshwar Dam and Devaliya Safari Park. Departure from Gir.

packages.name: Statue of Unity & Saputara Hill Station
packages.description: Combine a visit to the world's tallest statue with a refreshing hill station retreat. Explore the magnificent Statue of Unity and then relax in the cool climate of Saputara, Gujarat's only hill station. This package includes accommodation, transportation, and guided tours.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Statue of Unity
itinerary.description: Arrive at Vadodara. Drive to Kevadia. Visit the Statue of Unity, Valley of Flowers, and enjoy the laser show.

itinerary.title: Kevadia to Saputara
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Sardar Sarovar Dam. Drive to Saputara Hill Station. Evening at Sunset Point.

itinerary.title: Saputara & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning boat ride on Saputara Lake. Visit Tribal Museum and local markets. Departure for Vadodara/Surat.
